info.title: Payment Hub
info.description: Multi-project payment orchestration MVP. Saved cards only. Monetary values are minor units. Month intervals are capped at 120; Pagar.me uses BRL only. POST responses are idempotent by exact path and body. The API key is server-side only. Checkout supports Pagar.me card tokenization with per-project public key; see docs/checkout.md.

post.description: Project Bearer keys may retry their own tenant deliveries. Failed/dead only, no active lease; other states or foreign events return 404. Resets attempts and requeues the same snapshot. Console project sessions retain admin-only retry restriction (403), including the console v1 bridge.

get.summary: List latest 100 immutable subscription monetary credit entries

OfferInput.description: Single purchase with amount/currency/credits, existing recurring plan_id, or new recurring plan using amount/currency/credits/interval_unit/interval_count. Amount is integer cents. Existing plan defines amount/credits.

CheckoutPayInput.description: Card requires card_token; Pix/boleto prohibit token and require one installment. Values and permitted methods are read from session snapshot. Recurring requires card, one installment and explicit consent.

secret.description: Empty/omitted preserves saved secret. Initial secret requires 10–512 characters; prefixes must match environment.

public_key.description: Empty/omitted preserves saved public key; otherwise pk_ prefix matching environment.

retry_window_seconds.description: 0 defaults to 240; otherwise at least 30. Pagar.me test maximum 240. Both webhook fields empty preserve saved values; otherwise supply both.

url.description: HTTPS public endpoint, port 443/default only. No credentials or fragments.

signing_secret.description: Returned only on creation/rotation and matching idempotent replays; never returned by GET.

max_amount.description: Optional maximum authorized payment in cents; use preview amount_due.

charge_id.description: Empty if no payment is required.
